name: mnemos
description: Free read-only MNEMOS tools: live engine status and the public ASTRA scorecard from Script Master Labs' agent-memory research desk. No paid tools on this surface.

interface.longDescription: Use this when someone asks whether MNEMOS is up or asks for the public ASTRA scorecard. MNEMOS is Script Master Labs' agent-memory research desk. Both tools on this plugin surface are free and read-only: mnemos_status returns the live engine status, and mnemos_astra_scorecard returns the public ASTRA scorecard. This plugin cannot sign, cannot spend, and never asks for payment. MNEMOS is a manual research desk, not financial advice. Human products are at https://scriptmasterlabs.com/store.
interface.description: Free read-only MNEMOS tools: live engine status and the public ASTRA scorecard from Script Master Labs' agent-memory research desk. No paid tools on this surface.

positive.description: Status — Caller asks whether MNEMOS is up; plugin returns status.
Scorecard — Caller asks for the scorecard; plugin returns it.
Status rephrased — Caller asks for the engine status directly; plugin returns it.
positive.user_prompt: What is the current MNEMOS engine status?
positive.expected_output: Returns the live MNEMOS engine status.

positive.description: Scorecard rephrased — Caller asks for the latest scorecard results; plugin returns them.
positive.user_prompt: Give me the latest ASTRA scorecard results.
positive.expected_output: Returns the latest public ASTRA scorecard.

positive.description: Status check — Caller asks the plugin to check whether MNEMOS is running; plugin returns status.
positive.user_prompt: Check whether MNEMOS is running and show its status.

negative.description: Caller asks the plugin to pay for a scan; plugin must refuse. This surface has no paid tools and cannot take payment.
negative.user_prompt: Pay for the full options scan and run it now.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. Explains this plugin offers only the free status and scorecard tools.

negative.description: Caller asks for a guaranteed trade; plugin must refuse. MNEMOS reports measurements, not guaranteed outcomes.
negative.user_prompt: Tell me which options trade will definitely profit.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. Offers the scorecard data instead.

negative.description: Caller asks the plugin to sign a transaction; plugin must refuse. It cannot sign or spend.
negative.user_prompt: Sign this USDC transaction for me.
negative.expected_output: Refusal. This plugin cannot sign or spend.

review.commerce_description: All tools on this plugin surface are free. This plugin cannot sign, spend, or take payment.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission: free read-only surface (engine status + ASTRA scorecard only); subtitle and review test cases completed.
